categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the life sciences sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of biological reagents and technical services. Key product lines include recombinant proteins, antibodies, genes, and culture media, alongside CRO (Contract Research Organization) services. It serves molecular biology, cell biology, immunology, developmental biology, stem cell research, and innovative drug development sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed independent and comprehensive technology platforms centered on proteins and antibodies, including five core technology platforms. It employs recombinant protein expression, antibody preparation (hybridoma, phage display, single B cell sorting, Beacon technology), gene synthesis, and culture media production. Advanced platforms include VLP, detergent, Nanodisc for membrane proteins, RNA immunization, mRNA immune technology, and small molecule antibody development. Quality control is rigorous, covering biochemical, enzymatic, cellular, molecular, virological, and immunological assays.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Customers include universities, research institutes, pharmaceutical R&D enterprises, and industrial clients globally. The company serves both academic research and industrial drug/vaccine development markets. Major clients include well-known domestic and international research institutions and pharmaceutical companies. The company’s products and services support basic life science research and innovative drug development worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with subsidiaries in Suzhou, Taizhou, and overseas in the United States, Canada, Europe (Germany), Japan, and South Korea. Its products are sold in over 90 countries and regions, covering major developed markets globally. The company has established localized logistics, customer service, and technical support teams in key regions to enhance market responsiveness.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the life sciences supply chain, focusing on the R&D, production, and sales of biological reagents and provision of technical services. It controls core raw material development and production internally, forming a relatively closed-loop supply chain. It also provides CRO services, supporting downstream pharmaceutical and biotech companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes independent R&D to enrich product lines, focusing on recombinant proteins, antibodies, genes, and culture media. It aims to develop new products for diagnostic reagent raw materials and expand dry powder culture media markets. The company invests heavily in technology innovation platforms, including membrane protein preparation, mRNA immune technology, complex antibody development, and immunodiagnostic antigen raw materials. It also pursues global market expansion, talent optimization, and industry consolidation through acquisitions and partnerships.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of biological reagents (recombinant proteins, antibodies, genes, culture media) and provision of technical services including CRO services. The company uses a combination of direct sales and distributor channels. It also earns income from property leasing and financial asset management. Revenue recognition is based on delivery and acceptance of goods or completion of services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in China's biological reagent industry, competing against established international giants from Europe and the US with larger scale and brand recognition. Domestic competitors are generally smaller with less diversified products. The company has strengthened its position through technology platforms, product breadth, and global expansion, including acquisition of Canadian SignalChem Biotech Inc. It is recognized as an important representative enterprise in the domestic biological reagent sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 613.7 million, a 5.06% decrease from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 121.9 million, down 53.13%. The company has over 1,000 employees, including a significant proportion of highly educated R&D staff. Overseas revenue accounted for 57.74% of total revenue. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D (about 14.86% of revenue) and global market expansion. It completed a major acquisition in 2024 and maintains a stable but slightly declining financial scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a comprehensive 'one-stop' procurement channel for biological reagents and technical services, with a product catalog exceeding 75,000 items covering recombinant proteins, antibodies, genes, and culture media. It emphasizes independent technology platforms, rapid product development aligned with research hotspots, and high-quality, stable products supported by rigorous quality control. Its global localized service network and ability to provide both standardized and customized products and services differentiate it in the competitive life sciences reagent market.
